items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: of the rap artists I like Snoop Dog. I think he’s got a groove, he swings, he’s humorous.

ctx.x: Well that reminds me of when my father would come into the room when I was playing The Beatles and he’d go, “what’s wrong with your record player?” Some things never change.

Well that’s interesting. I mean I think that, I mean my parents, interestingly enough, they liked The Beatles. My parents recognized good songs. So it didn’t bother them. They thought The Beatles were cute. You know because we were going nuts. I think that your argument has to be well defended. And if you can specifically say here’s what I don’t like about this and here’s what I do like about that. I mean of the rap artists I like Snoop Dog. I think he’s got a groove, he swings, he’s humorous. I don’t like — I’m…
Well you have a solo record out now, correct?
